title: Edition Capability Preset
description: One row in EditionCapabilityPresets. Maps a (product, segment) pair to the default cap-set. The minter expands this on the server side; the verifier expands it on the client side. Both sides must read the same table — that's why the table lives here.

product.description: The token prd claim. Matches the values the minter writes and the verifier reads.

segment.description: The token seg claim. null means 'segment not set' (the legacy single-axis token shape).

displayName.description: Operator-facing preset name ('Pro Team', 'Enterprise', 'Pro Developer'). The portal renders this on the preset-shortcut row.

capabilities.description: Capability keys this preset expands to. Every key must exist in the capability catalog (validation step in the render pipeline).

operatorNote.description: Portal copy explaining what the preset is good for. Surfaces under the preset-shortcut button.

since.description: First version of MMP.Licensing.Contracts that shipped this preset.
